يبتدرون (form VIII)
# يَبْتَدِرُونَ (yabtadirūna) /jab.ta.di.ruː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِبْتَدَرَ (ibtadara)
# يُبْتَدَرُونَ (yubtadarūna) /jub.ta.da.ruː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِبْتَدَرَ (ibtadara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
